P003 (p1-G01-1): expose a module-callable RDAP helper (e.g. rdap_domain_facts(ctx, domain) -> minimised facts) and stable registry source ids so typosquat can add rdap_org.redirector + rdap_* sources for gTLD candidates (derived tier then 'community' as the council set).

ctx.sleep()/a public run clock, or a rate parameter on ctx.dns for bulk DoH modules: typosquat paces DoH at <= 10 q/s through ctx.runtime.clock.
A per-preset (deep) request allowance for default-enabled modules: P012 cond 6 wants 20 RDAP lookups with --preset deep while A3 caps max_requests at 10.

A core URL-redaction helper with the P312 detectors (session ids, e-mail addresses, JWTs, opaque tokens, the userinfo user part): web_archives carries redact_archived_url as a stand-in after redact.redact_url.
Terminal renderer: show attribute typosquat_top (top 10 by score) and send typosquat_lookalikes to HTML/JSON (P012 cond 10).
Stop reasons for capped answers ('row_cap', 'body_truncated'): web_archives marks a truncated or capped CDX answer partial with stop_reason 'request_cap' (the only fitting STOP_REASON).
Rule-derived attributes (or confirm the correlation): P059 cond 8 first_seen is emitted as the INFO correlation web_archives_first_seen; confirm P001's CT attribute name 'first_cert_seen'.
A named 'protected lists' API (or a stable dataset name from P360/P009): typosquat discovers the BCB DominiosVerificados dataset by registry source + URL.
P030 watch: use typosquat_permutations.generate()/rank(limit=500)/reverse_match() for local matching (the 500-candidate watch cap).
notes: Two proposals delivered as five modules. P012: typosquat (offline reverse mode on every domain seed; DoH forward scan only for org_profile domains/brands or -M typosquat; run_on seeds) and the opt-in typosquat_dnstwister (cond 11). P059: web_archives (default: Wayback availability + one CDX summary + archived homepage id_ indicators, Arquivo.pt for .br/.pt/Portuguese sites and as fallback, 15 s budget), web_archives_deep (Common Crawl latest 1-2 crawls with backoff + WARC homepage record + CarbonDate; split out because CarbonDate's provider is fetches_target, which A3 forbids in a default-enabled module, and because the deep sources run only with --preset deep or -M) and web_archives_ukwa (disabled until it answers). Providers created: dnstwister, arquivo_pt, odu_carbondate (fetches_target true), ukwa; extensions commoncrawl__p1-G01-2 (host data.commoncrawl.org, source web_archives_deep_warc) and internet_archive__p1-G01-2 (source web_archives_cdx + IA error markers). No core or other batch file was edited. Terms decisions: dnstwister 'unknown' (homepage moved to the commercial dnstwister.com on 2026-11-26, no terms for the free API); UKWA 'unknown' (terms page unreachable); Arquivo.pt 'open' per the binding council text, with the terms page quote ('Use for commercial purposes is strictly forbidden') recorded in the source notes for legal review. typosquat expected_latency 2.0 s is the p50 of the default (offline reverse) path; a forward scan takes 15-40 s within the 45 s timeout. NXDOMAIN 'unregistered' is confirmed by a second resolver (P029 cond 10) within the DoH budget; names left unconfirmed are counted as nxdomain_unconfirmed, never unregistered. P327 lint (lint_module_source/lint_data_file) clean on every module and data file of the batch; ruff clean on every batch file. Fixture provenance: real DoH/RDAP/BCB/dnstwister/availability/Arquivo.pt/collinfo/CarbonDate/UKWA bodies (minimised, documentation values); synthetic Wayback CDX bodies and the per-crawl Common Crawl CDX (unreachable from the datacenter egress) and the golden-path CDX route; WARC records are built in the test from the real example.com page. Full offline suite: the only failures are in core tests (tests/test_engine_status_mapping.py 12, tests/test_context.py 1, tests/test_datasets.py 1) and other batches' files (tests/test_links.py 2 from new pivot packs, tests/modules/test_url_domain_blocklists.py 1); re-run once, unchanged, none touches this batch.
